facts.statement: The genus Pradhania was first named by T. S. Kutty, Sankar Chatterjee, Peter M. Galton, and Paul Upchurch in 2007.
facts.quote: It was first named by T. S. Kutty, Sankar Chatterjee, Peter M. Galton and Paul Upchurch in 2007

facts.statement: The genus name honors Dhuiya Pradhan, a fossil collector who worked for the Indian Statistical Institute.
facts.quote: El nombre del género honra al "experto" excavador de fósiles Dhuiya Pradhan, que trabaja para el Instituto de Estadística de la India

facts.statement: Pradhania lived during the Early Jurassic, approximately 196 million years ago, in what is now the Indian subcontinent.
facts.quote: que vivió a principios del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 196 millones de años, en el Sinemuriense, en que es hoy el subcontinente indio

facts.statement: Pradhania was a modest-sized sauropodomorph, reaching about four meters (13 feet) in length.
facts.quote: It was a sauropodomorph of modest size, only about four meters (13 ft) long

facts.statement: A unique feature of Pradhania is a prominent horizontal crest on the inside of the upper jaw.
facts.quote: Un autapomorfismo es que el maxilar tiene una cresta horizontal prominente en el interior

facts.statement: The upper jaw of Pradhania contained 20 teeth, a high number for its group.
facts.quote: El maxilar tiene 20 dientes, un número elevado pero sin registro

facts.statement: The teeth of Pradhania were spatulate and symmetrical.
facts.quote: Los dientes son espatulados y simétricos

facts.statement: Pradhania possessed a large thumb claw typical of basal sauropodomorphs.
facts.quote: La mano tiene la forma normal de los sauropodomorfos basales, con una gran garra del pulgar

facts.statement: Evidence suggests Pradhania normally walked on its hind legs as a biped.
facts.quote: Esto indica que Pradhania normalmente caminaba sobre sus patas traseras como bípedo

facts.statement: Pradhania had very elongated neck vertebrae, a derived characteristic noted by its describers.
facts.quote: Los descriptores ya notaron la longitud de las vértebras cervicales, una característica derivada

facts.statement: While originally thought to be a basal sauropodomorph, later analysis suggests Pradhania belongs to the family Massospondylidae.
facts.quote: It was originally regarded as a basal sauropodomorph but new cladistic analysis performed by Novas et al., 2011 suggests that Pradhania is a massospondylid

facts.statement: A new cladistic analysis by Novas et al. in 2011 suggests Pradhania is a massospondylid rather than a basal sauropodomorph.
facts.quote: Originalmente fue considerado como un sauropodomorfo basal pero un nuevo análisis cladístico realizado por Novas et al. en 2011 sugiere que Pradhania es un masospondilido

facts.statement: The holotype fossil, ISI R265, was found in the Sinemurian-age Dharmaram Formation.
facts.quote: El fósil, el holotipo ISI R265, se encontró en una capa de la formación Dharmara que se remonta al período Sinemuriano hace 196 millones de años

facts.statement: The known fossil material consists of a partial skeleton including a skull.
facts.quote: Consiste en un esqueleto parcial con cráneo

facts.statement: Pradhania lived from the Hettangian to the Sinemurian stages, between 201.4 and 192.9 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Hettangian to Sinemurian (201.4 to 192.9 million years ago)
